answer: The river lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the vertex is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on invitation quota tree, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
